⚠⚠ **本層擋下策展層最大的一處正文風險：〈Festival Journey〉不是 Max Roach 寫的。** **Discogs 1110614（1996 美國原壓 CD）的逐軌 credit 逐字寫死**：〈Festival Journey〉**`Frederick Tillis — Composed By`**、**`David Epstein — Conductor`**、`Stephanie Rogers — Engineer`、**`Max Roach — Soloist, Drums`**——**Roach 在這一軌的身分是「獨奏者」，作曲與指揮都是別人。** 〈Ghost Dance〉那一軌的 credit 才是另一組人：**`Max Roach — Drums [Trap]`、`Marshall Sealy — French Horn`、`Steve Turre — Trombone`、`Cecil Bridgewater — Trumpet`、`Frank Gordon — Trumpet`、`Bob Stewart — Tuba`**——**五件銅管 ＋ 一套鼓，這才是盤名裡的 So What Brass Quintet。** 全碟 credit 另有 `Max Roach — Producer`、`Bruce Lundvall — Executive Producer`、`Max Roach — Liner Notes`、`Allan Tucker — Mastered By`、`Patrick Roques — Design`、`Chuck Stewart／Susan J. Ross — Photography`。

⚠ **這張碟不是一天錄完的，兩軌差了將近兩年、地點也不同。** **Discogs 1110614 的 notes 逐字**：「"Festival Journey" was recorded on **December 2, 1993 at the University of Massachusetts, Amherst.**」「"Ghost Dance" recorded on **October 5, 1995 at the Sound On Sound Studio, New York City.**」companies 欄與之一致：`Recorded At: University Of Massachusetts`、`Recorded At: Sound On Sound, New York`、`Mixed At: Sound Mirror, Jamaica Plain, MA`、`Mixed At: Sound On Sound, New York`、`Mastered At: Foothill Digital`、`Glass Mastered At: EMI MFG.`、℗© `Capitol Records, Inc.`。**正文不得寫成一次錄音，也不得把兩軌寫成同一批人。**

⚠ **紙本是本組最厚的一筆，而且 Billboard 自己就把作曲者寫死了。** **Billboard 1996-04-20 p1 頭版導言 ＋ p60 全文（Jim Macnie，標題「BLUE NOTE'S ROACH GETS ORCHESTRAL」）**：發行時點逐字「"Max Roach With The New Orchestra Of Boston & The So What Brass **Ensemble**," **slated for worldwide release through EMI on Tuesday (16)**」＝**1996-04-16 全球街頭日**；曲目描述逐字「Anchored by a **50-minute piece titled "Festival Journey,"** it features the virtuoso percussionist **soloing through three movements** that collectively conjure both **Dvoiik**[Dvořák]**and Ellington**, with evocative subtitles, such as **"Outbursts," "Drones," and "Strutting."**」；作曲歸屬逐字「**"Festival Journey" was composed by Fred Tillis.** He and Roach struck up a relationship at the **University of Massachusetts** when the drummer taught there in the '80s.」；Roach 談 Tillis 逐字「Fred's from Texas, plays a hell of a tenor, and has that raw-boned thing the Southern tenors are known for」。

同一篇 Billboard 1996-04-20 p60 把〈Ghost Dance〉的身分也寫死：逐字「**"Ghost Dance," the 12-minute piece by the So What Brass Band that closes the disc, is the work of a wholly separate unit** that Roach hopes to develop over the next few years, **similar to his work with the Uptown String Quartet in the '80s.**」；生涯定位逐字「Roach's excursion is **his first recording done under contract for a U.S. label since his stint with Columbia in the late '70s.** The drummer spent much of the '80s recording for the **Milan-based Soul Note label**」（並舉 In The Light／Bright Moments／Survivors 三張）；Bruce Lundvall（Blue Note 總裁、當年把 Roach 簽進 Columbia 的人）逐字「Max is one of the originators of contemporary jazz, and he's still playing like he has always played: great … **He may be in his 70s, but in terms of spirit and direction, I find him to be the youngest guy on the roster.**」；行銷副總 Tom Evered 逐字「We're going right to **classical and jazz radio and classical and jazz retail**, too … 〈Festival Journey〉could go to eclectic classical stations, while〈Ghost Dance〉has more of a jazz feel」。**另記：Roach 同月 16–21 日在紐約 Iridium 演出、自傳交 Simon and Schuster、1995 年曾以 M'Boom 辦打擊峰會（Ginger Baker、Tony Williams）。**

sound: 十一軌的五重奏：Marcus Printup 的小號、Marcus Roberts 的鋼琴、Stephen Riley 的次中音薩克斯、Reuben Rogers 的低音提琴、Jason Marsalis 的鼓。曲長多半四到七分，最長的〈Soulful J〉七分半、最短的收尾〈Amazing Grace〉兩分半。曲目六首是 Printup 自己寫的，外來曲三首來自三個世代：Miles Davis 的〈Dig〉、Benny Golson 的〈Stablemates〉、Wayne Shorter 的〈Yes or No〉。兩軌是小號與鋼琴的二重奏（〈M & M〉與〈Amazing Grace〉）。1996 年 2 月 18、19 兩天在紐約 Sound On Sound 直接錄到兩軌類比母帶，Bob Belden 與 Printup 共同製作。
